rubric.text: Transforms the energy surface by local minimization: a configuration is scored by the energy of the minimum reached from it, not by its own energy, which turns the surface into a set of plateaus and leaves the global minimum unchanged.
Runs a Monte Carlo walk that accepts or rejects a step using a Metropolis criterion at finite temperature applied to the *minimized* energies, rather than only accepting downhill steps.
After an accepted step the walk continues from the minimized configuration, so it hops between basins instead of wandering the raw surface.
Adapts the displacement size during the run to hold the acceptance ratio near a target of about one half.

Handles poorly bound surface atoms specially, for example by moving the atom with the highest pair energy to a new point on the cluster surface, or by containing atoms so the cluster cannot evaporate.
Uses a gradient-based local optimizer for the minimization step.

provenance: Rubric written from cond-mat/9803344 Secs. 2-3 before any scored run. Global minima independently reproduced by multistart optimization in tests/test_domain_evaluators.py.
